title: Disable Nagle's Algorithm
name: disable-nagles-algorithm
description: Disables Nagle's Algorithm to reduce TCP latency for online gaming.
deepDescription: Disables Nagle's Algorithm on all network interfaces by setting TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1. This prevents TCP packet batching that adds latency, making every packet sent immediately. Critical for real-time applications like online gaming and video calls.
